text_en: Then Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus from Jerusalem and said,
text_cn: 那时，有法利塞人和经师，从耶路撒冷来到耶稣跟前说：

text_en: “Why do your disciples break the tradition of the elders? For they do not wash their hands before they eat. ”
text_cn: “你的门徒为什么违犯先人的传授？他们吃饭时竟不洗手。”

text_en: He answered them, “And why do you break the commandment of God for the sake of your tradition?
text_cn: 耶稣回答他们说：“你们为什么为了你们的传授，而违犯天主的诫命呢？

text_en: For God said, ‘Honor your father and your mother, ’ and, ‘Whoever speaks evil of father or mother must surely die. ’
text_cn: 天主曾说过：‘你要孝敬父亲和母亲。’又说过：‘咒骂父亲和母亲的，应处以死刑。’

text_en: But you say that whoever tells father or mother, ‘Whatever support you might have had from me is given to God, ’ then that person need not honor the father.
text_cn: 你们却说：谁若对父亲或母亲说：我所能供养你的，已成了献仪；

text_en: So, for the sake of your tradition, you make void the word of God.
text_cn: 他就不必再孝敬父亲或母亲了。你们就为了你们的传授，废弃了天主的话。

text_en: You hypocrites! Isaiah prophesied rightly about you when he said:
text_cn: 假善人哪！依撒意亚论你们预言的真好，他说：

text_en: ‘This people honors me with their lips, but their hearts are far from me;
text_cn: ‘这民族用嘴唇尊敬我，他们的心却是远离我；

text_en: in vain do they worship me, teaching human precepts as doctrines. ’”
text_cn: 他们恭敬我也是假的，因为他们所讲授的教义是人的规律。’”

text_en: Then he called the crowd to him and said to them, “Listen and understand:
text_cn: 耶稣便叫过群众来，对他们说：“你们听，且要明白：

text_en: it is not what goes into the mouth that defiles a person, but it is what comes out of the mouth that defiles. ”
text_cn: 不是入于口的，使人污秽；而是出于口的，才使人污秽。”

text_en: Then the disciples approached and said to him, “Do you know that the Pharisees took offense when they heard what you said? ”
text_cn: 那时，门徒前来告诉耶稣说：“你知道法利塞人听了这话，起了反感吗？”

text_en: He answered, “Every plant that my heavenly Father has not planted will be uprooted.
text_cn: 耶稣答说：“任何植物，凡不是我天父所种植的，必要连根拔除。

text_en: Let them alone; they are blind guides of the blind. And if one blind person guides another, both will fall into a pit. ”
text_cn: 由他们吧！他们是瞎子，且是瞎子的领路人；但若瞎子领瞎子，两人必要掉在坑里。”

text_en: But Peter said to him, “Explain this parable to us. ”
text_cn: 伯多禄遂应声对耶稣说：“请你给我们讲解这个比喻吧！”

text_en: Then he said, “Are you also still without understanding?
text_cn: 耶稣说：“连你们也不明白吗？

text_en: Do you not see that whatever goes into the mouth enters the stomach, and goes out into the sewer?
text_cn: 你们不晓得：凡入于口的，先到肚腹内，然后排泄到厕所里去吗？

text_en: But what comes out of the mouth proceeds from the heart, and this is what defiles.
text_cn: 但那从口里出来的，都是由心里发出来的，这些才使人污秽，

text_en: For out of the heart come evil intentions, murder, adultery, fornication, theft, false witness, slander.
text_cn: 因为由心里发出来的是恶念、凶杀、奸淫、邪淫、盗窃、妄证、毁谤。

text_en: These are what defile a person, but to eat with unwashed hands does not defile. ”
text_cn: 这些都使人污秽，至于不洗手吃饭，并不能使人污秽。”

text_en: Jesus left that place and went away to the district of Tyre and Sidon.
text_cn: 耶稣离开那里，就退往提洛和漆冬一带去了。

text_en: Just then a Canaanite woman from that region came out and started shouting, “Have mercy on me, Lord, Son of David; my daughter is tormented by a demon. ”
text_cn: 看，有一个客纳罕妇人，从那地方出来喊说：“主，达味之子，可怜我吧！我的女儿被魔纠缠的好苦啊！”

text_en: But he did not answer her at all. And his disciples came and urged him, saying, “Send her away, for she keeps shouting after us. ”
text_cn: 耶稣却一句话也不回答她。他的门徒就上前求他说：“打发她走吧！因为她在我们后面不停地喊叫。”

text_en: He answered, “I was sent only to the lost sheep of the house of Israel. ”
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“我被派遣，只是为了以色列家失迷的羊。”

text_en: But she came and knelt before him, saying, “Lord, help me. ”
text_cn: 那妇人却前来叩拜他说：“主，援助我吧！”

text_en: He answered, “It is not fair to take the children’s food and throw it to the dogs. ”
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“拿儿女的饼扔给小狗，是不对的。”

text_en: She said, “Yes, Lord, yet even the dogs eat the crumbs that fall from their masters’ table. ”
text_cn: 但她说：“是啊！主，可是小狗也吃主人桌子上掉下来的碎屑。”

text_en: Then Jesus answered her, “Woman, great is your faith! Let it be done for you as you wish. ” And her daughter was healed instantly.
text_cn: 耶稣回答她说：“啊！妇人，你的信德真大，就如你所愿望的，给你成就吧！”从那时刻起，她的女儿就痊愈了。

text_en: After Jesus had left that place, he passed along the Sea of Galilee, and he went up the mountain, where he sat down.
text_cn: 耶稣离开了那里，来到加里肋亚海岸，上了山坐在那里。

text_en: Great crowds came to him, bringing with them the lame, the maimed, the blind, the mute, and many others. They put them at his feet, and he cured them,
text_cn: 于是有许多群众带着瘸子、残废、瞎子、哑巴，和许多其他的病人来到耶稣跟前，把他们放在他的足前，他便治好了他们；

text_en: so that the crowd was amazed when they saw the mute speaking, the maimed whole, the lame walking, and the blind seeing. And they praised the God of Israel.
text_cn: 致使群众见到哑巴说话，残废康复，瘸子行走，瞎子看见，都大为惊奇，颂扬以色列的天主。

text_en: Then Jesus called his disciples to him and said, “I have compassion for the crowd, because they have been with me now for three days and have nothing to eat; and I do not want to send them away hungry, for they might faint on the way. ”
text_cn: 耶稣将自己的门徒召来说：“我很怜悯这群众，因为他们同我在一起已经三天，也没有什么可吃的；我不愿遣散他们空着肚子回去，怕他们在路上晕倒。”

text_en: The disciples said to him, “Where are we to get enough bread in the desert to feed so great a crowd? ”
text_cn: 门徒对他说：“在荒野里我们从哪里得这么多的饼，使这么多的群众吃饱呢？”

text_en: Jesus asked them, “How many loaves have you? ” They said, “Seven, and a few small fish. ”
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“你们有多少饼？”他们说：“七个，还有几条小鱼。”

text_en: Then ordering the crowd to sit down on the ground,
text_cn: 耶稣就吩咐群众坐在地上，

text_en: he took the seven loaves and the fish; and after giving thanks he broke them and gave them to the disciples, and the disciples gave them to the crowds.
text_cn: 拿起七个饼和鱼来，祝谢了，擘开，递给门徒；门徒再分给群众。

text_en: And all of them ate and were filled; and they took up the broken pieces left over, seven baskets full.
text_cn: 众人都吃了，也都饱了，把剩下的碎块收集了满满七篮子。

text_en: Those who had eaten were four thousand men, besides women and children.
text_cn: 吃的人数，除妇女和孩子外，约有四千人。

text_en: After sending away the crowds, he got into the boat and went to the region of Magadan.
text_cn: 耶稣遣散了群众，就上船，来到玛加丹境内。
